items.name: System Overview
items.description: The Vehicle Control System (VCS) shall provide integrated control of vehicle propulsion, braking, and steering functions.

items.name: Propulsion Control
items.description: The VCS shall control vehicle propulsion based on driver throttle input and system constraints.

items.name: Brake Control
items.description: The VCS shall control vehicle braking based on driver brake input and safety system commands.

items.name: Steering Control
items.description: The VCS shall provide electric power steering assist proportional to vehicle speed and driver input.

items.name: Sensor Integration
items.description: The VCS shall integrate data from wheel speed sensors, throttle position sensor, brake pressure sensor, and steering angle sensor.

items.name: Communication Bus
items.description: The VCS shall communicate via CAN bus at 500 kbps with all vehicle subsystems.

items.name: Response Time
items.description: The VCS shall respond to driver inputs within 50ms under normal operating conditions.

items.name: Operating Temperature
items.description: The VCS shall operate within specifications at ambient temperatures from -40C to +85C.
